verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-defined rules engine where events trigger configured actions. Webhooks/IPN notifications are a developer building block: a developer must write the logic that acts on them. Automatic retries on rejected subscription payments and the manual/automatic processing choice are fixed built-in behaviors, not user-authored event-to-action rules, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
